scripts.build:js: jco transpile plugin/target/wasm32-wasip2/release/example_plugin.wasm --name example-plugin -o dist/js --instantiation async --no-wasi-shim --async-mode jspi --async-imports ctvs:example-plugin/http#get --async-exports fetch
scripts.build:package: npm run build:component && npm run build:js && node tools/assets.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build: npm run build:package && npm run build:host
scripts.build:typescript: npm run build:package && tsc -p typescript/tsconfig.json && node tools/build-typescript.js && jco transpile dist/typescript/plugin.wasm --name example-plugin -o dist/typescript/js --instantiation async --no-wasi-shim --async-mode jspi --async-imports ctvs:example-plugin/http#get --async-exports fetch
scripts.test:typescript: npm run build:typescript && npm run build:host && EXAMPLE_PLUGIN_GUEST=typescript node --test test/*.test.js
